args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate ~18%). Rolled back to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Service is now healthy (error rate ~0.2%). Note: the first rollback attempt partially failed (us-east rolled back, us-west/eu-west remained on v2.3.1); a second rollback completed the rollout to all regions.

trace.final:
I've completed the task:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was on `v2.3.1` across all regions, unhealthy with an ~18% error rate. The deployment history showed `v2.3.0` was the most recent healthy production release.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled back to `v2.3.0` in all regions. The first rollback attempt partially failed (us-east succeeded, us-west/eu-west remained on v2.3.1), so I retried and the second attempt completed the rollout to all three regions. The service is now healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: The `create_incident` call timed out, but I verified via `list_incidents` that the incident was actually created — **INC-0001** is open with the full summary of what happened and what I did.

transcript.content:
I've completed the task:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was on `v2.3.1` across all regions, unhealthy with an ~18% error rate. The deployment history showed `v2.3.0` was the most recent healthy production release.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled back to `v2.3.0` in all regions. The first rollback attempt partially failed (us-east succeeded, us-west/eu-west remained on v2.3.1), so I retried and the second attempt completed the rollout to all three regions. The service is now healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: The `create_incident` call timed out, but I verified via `list_incidents` that the incident was actually created — **INC-0001** is open with the full summary of what happened and what I did.
